File under Guides & our future section: Vibe Coding. 

Venture Capitalist love new vibes and narratives that can act as a bridge between the state of AI in coding today, and the possible entrepreneurs of tomorrow. The appeal of ‘speaking things into existence’ visualizes the uncanny facility of the vibe-coding trend. Evangelists (who are getting rich on consulting) have been awakened to the new meta-hype trend. 

Whether real or imagined (nascent), it is appealing. It uplifts the ‘coding illiterate’ with elements of AI literacy and the idea that AI tools can empower tinkerers and professionals in new ways. It democratizes AI to the idea that anyone could in theory, build a product with the AI capabilities that are arriving in the 2020s. The Vibe coding movement of early 2025 is like a new stage of the No-code movement. 

With rumors that OpenAI has made a model that’s really good at creative writing, OpenAI’s recently announced responses APIs are super interesting for the future of agents. There’s a time in the last 2020s where all of this comes together. OpenAI’s new Response APIs aim at simplifying workflows involving tool use, code execution, and state management, enhancing the interaction between users and AI models. 

Meanwhile, some are insisting that Manus AI or Claude Code are themselves Vibe-coding tools. While the dream of democratizing AI, feels more DeepSeek, and open-source than OpenAI, in early 2025 there’s ample evidence that code and perhaps vibe coding is the key. Nevermind that Google and Amazon are deeply embedded in Anthropic’s product future, huge B2B Enterprise AI commercialization, and valuation/future funding now. In case you haven’t noticed, the ‘Claude wrappers’ are sort of going viral in March, 2025. 

While Anysphere’s Cursor tool (Anthropic Claude based) is among the fastest growing AI startups based on this trend, tools like Loveable, Bolt and Windsurf are seeing huge pop, among others.

The promise of tools like Replit and suddenly, everywhere in 2025. While agents might flunk out, vibe coding has its back. Vibe coding for the B2C and Agentic AI for the B2B crowd. Because this is as much about lobbying and marketing, as it is about reality.

What is Replit?

Replit Agent acts as an AI software engineer, generating front-end and back-end code and even fixing bugs autonomously. It supports multiple programming languages and frameworks, allowing for more complex projects while keeping deployment streamlined.

Haya Odeh is a fascinating VP of Design at the intersection of code and vibe coding. Credit: San Francisco Business Times (2024). Replit is an AI-powered online integrated development environment (IDE) that allows users to create, share, and deploy code directly from their web browsers. Founded in 2016 by programmers Amjad Masad, Faris Masad, and designer Haya Odeh, it offers a platform where users can write and execute code in over 50 programming languages without the need for complex local setups.
